scope: Loaded-registration evidence for the modified plugins in an isolated service instance. Not tool-execution, model, GUI or human acceptance.
method: Started the built client (commit 0.0.0-detached-202611022059) with OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR unset and HOME/XDG pointed at an empty tree, created one session at the repository location, then read the read-only plugin inventory. The shared service was never touched.
previousBlocker: Earlier attempts returned an empty inventory because OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR in the environment forced the pilot profile; unsetting it for the child made project configuration discovery work.
interpretation: The five project plugins — computer-use.desktop, goal-docs, memory, self-learning and the goal-mode server — load from this repository and register active in a real service. Because their source files include today's edits, this is loaded-registration proof for those edits, stronger than the earlier selected-source inventory. It is still not proof that any specific new code path executed.
cleanup: The isolated service was stopped; a process scan finds zero processes for the built binary and the shared service pid 6628 is unchanged.
limits: Registration is not tool execution: the public client cannot invoke a registered tool.
No model, GUI/audio or human layer is exercised.
The isolated service used the built client, not the installed one, and its data directory is disposable.
